statement: theorem advance_sharp_bound (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (g x u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) : inner ℝ g (advance V η g x - u) ≤ (‖x - u‖ ^ 2 - ‖advance V η g x - u‖ ^ 2 - ‖advance V η g x - x‖ ^ 2) / (2 * η)
